```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code"

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(stringr)

url_2010_2023 <- "https://www.imdb.com/search/title/?title_type=feature&release_date=2010-01-01,2023-12-30&num_votes=2500,&country_of_origin=TR&count=250"
url_until_2010 <- "https://www.imdb.com/search/title/?title_type=feature&release_date=,2009-12-31&num_votes=2500,&country_of_origin=TR&count=250"

page1 <- read_html(url_2010_2023)
page2 <- read_html(url_until_2010)


titles_2010_2023 <- page1 |> html_nodes(".ipc-title__text") |> html_text()
titles_2010_2023 <- tail(head(titles_2010_2023,-1),-1)
titles_2010_2023 <- gsub("^\\d+\\.\\s*", "", titles_2010_2023)


titles_until_2010 <- page2 |> html_nodes(".ipc-title__text") |> html_text()
titles_until_2010 <- page2 |> html_nodes(".ipc-title__text") |> html_text()
titles_until_2010 <- tail(head(titles_until_2010,-1),-1)


years_2010_2023 <- page1 |> html_nodes(".dli-title-metadata-item:nth-child(1)") |> html_text()
years_until_2010 <- page2 |> html_nodes(".dli-title-metadata-item:nth-child(1)") |> html_text()

votes_2010_2023 <- page1 |> html_nodes(".ipc-rating-star--voteCount") |> html_text()
votes_until_2010 <- page2 |> html_nodes(".ipc-rating-star--voteCount") |> html_text()
votes_2010_2023 <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", votes_2010_2023)
votes_2010_2023 <- as.numeric(votes_2010_2023)
votes_2010_2023[votes_2010_2023 >= 1] <- votes_2010_2023[votes_2010_2023 >= 1] * 1000

votes_until_2010 <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", votes_until_2010)
votes_until_2010 <- as.numeric(votes_until_2010)
votes_until_2010[votes_until_2010 >= 1] <- votes_until_2010[votes_until_2010 >= 1] * 1000


durations_2010_2023 <- page1 |> html_nodes(".dli-title-metadata-item:nth-child(2)") |> html_text()
durations_until_2010 <- page2 |> html_nodes(".dli-title-metadata-item:nth-child(2)") |> html_text()


convert_to_minutes <- function(duration_text) {
  durations <- str_match(duration_text, "(\\d+)h\\s?(\\d*)m?") 
  hours <- as.numeric(durations[, 2])
  minutes <- as.numeric(durations[, 3])
  
  total_minutes <- (ifelse(is.na(hours), 0, hours) * 60) + ifelse(is.na(minutes), 0, minutes)
  
}


durations_2010_2023_minutes <- convert_to_minutes(durations_2010_2023)
durations_until_2010_minutes <- convert_to_minutes(durations_until_2010)


ratings_2010_2023 <- page1 |> html_nodes(".ratingGroup--imdb-rating") |> html_text()
ratings_until_2010 <- page2 |> html_nodes(".ratingGroup--imdb-rating") |> html_text()

ratings_2010_2023 <- str_extract(ratings_2010_2023, "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")
ratings_until_2010 <- str_extract(ratings_until_2010, "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")


titles <- c(titles_2010_2023, titles_until_2010)
years <- c(years_2010_2023, years_until_2010)
durations <- c(durations_2010_2023_minutes, durations_until_2010_minutes)
ratings <- c(ratings_2010_2023, ratings_until_2010)
votes <- c(votes_2010_2023, votes_until_2010)


movie_data <- data.frame(
  Title = titles,
  Year = years,
  Duration = durations,
  Rating = as.numeric(ratings),
  Votes = votes
)
```

#| echo: true

print(bottom_5)
favorite_titles <- c("A.R.O.G", "Yahsi Bati")
clean_titles <- gsub("^\\d+\\.\\s*", "", movie_data_sorted$Title)
favorite_titles_clean <- gsub("^\\d+\\.\\s*", "", favorite_titles)
favorite_movies_data <- movie_data_sorted %>%
  filter(tolower(clean_titles) %in% tolower(favorite_titles_clean))

print(favorite_movies_data)

#Grafikler ve analizler
```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code"
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Group by 'Year' and calculate average rating for each year
yearly_rating_avg <- movie_data %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Average_Rating = mean(as.numeric(Rating), na.rm = TRUE),
            Num_Movies = n())

# Plot 1: Scatter plot of average ratings per year
ggplot(yearly_rating_avg, aes(x = Year, y = Average_Rating)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Average Ratings of Turkish Movies Over the Years",
       x = "Year", y = "Average Rating") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) 

# Plot 2: Number of Movies Released per Year
ggplot(yearly_rating_avg, aes(x = Year, y = Num_Movies)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Number of Movies Released Per Year",
       x = "Year", y = "Number of Movies") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(min(yearly_rating_avg$Year), max(yearly_rating_avg$Year), by = 1))) + # Yıllar arası boşluğu artırıyoruz
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) 
# Box plot of ratings per year
ggplot(movie_data, aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = as.numeric(Rating))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Box Plot of Movie Ratings by Year",
       x = "Year", y = "Rating") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# First, make sure Votes and Rating are numeric
movie_data$Votes <- as.numeric(movie_data$Votes)
movie_data$Rating <- as.numeric(movie_data$Rating)

# Remove any rows with NA values for 'Votes' or 'Rating'
movie_data_clean <- movie_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Votes) & !is.na(Rating))

# Calculate correlation between Votes and Rating
correlation <- cor(movie_data_clean$Votes, movie_data_clean$Rating)

# Print the correlation coefficient
print(paste("Correlation between Votes and Rating:", round(correlation, 2)))

# Plotting the relationship between Votes and Rating
ggplot(movie_data_clean, aes(x = Votes, y = Rating)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
  labs(title = "Relationship between Votes and Rating",
       x = "Number of Votes", y = "Rating") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +  # Linear trend line
  theme_minimal()


# Clean the movie data (ensure 'Rating' and 'Duration' are numeric)
movie_data_clean <- movie_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rating) & !is.na(Duration))

# Calculate the correlation
correlation <- cor(movie_data_clean$Duration, movie_data_clean$Rating)

# Print the correlation coefficient
print(paste("Correlation between Duration and Rating:", round(correlation, 2)))

# Plotting the relationship between Duration and Rating
ggplot(movie_data_clean, aes(x = Duration, y = Rating)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +  # Scatter plot of points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +  # Add linear regression line
  labs(title = "Relationship between Movie Duration and Rating",
       x = "Duration (Minutes)", y = "Rating") +
  theme_minimal()
```
